title: Birds by Rares Chira-Ocneanu
overview: For millennia, the Auspex has ruled as the immortal guardian of the birds, quietly maintaining the balance between nature and mankind. Step into his world as he recounts the daily lives of his winged creatures... Until an unforeseen force tears that order apart, unleashing a nightmare that will forever alter the fate of Orpheus and Eurydice.  Blending psychological horror with Greek mythology, witness the beginning of a dark three-part tale of obsession, vengeance, power, and the devastating price of love and revenge.
